subject: QuickMart self-serve trial — qualifying questions + demo timing
messages:
From: Samira Patel <samira@quickmart.com>
To: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick start help — self-serve trial + next steps

Hi Priyom,

I signed up for a self-serve trial yesterday and have been running some quick calls against the hosted API. We're seeing promising relevance improvements for our search reranking experiments and want to formalize a short pilot. A few quick context points: 
- Use case: product search rerank + short personalized snippets for product detail pages.
- Current traffic: roughly 2M inference calls/day across web + mobile, peak ~120 QPS in the evening.
- Goal: pilot in Aug (4–6 week pilot) leading to a potential production roll in Q4.

Questions: would love a short demo tailored to our traffic profile and to confirm sandbox keys/limits. Also curious about latency expectations vs. cost for continuous reranking (95th pct target ~120ms).

I attached a small snapshot of yesterday's trial traffic and a CSV with a representative sample. If possible, could we get a 30–45 minute slot next week? I prefer mornings PST.

Thanks —
Samira
Samira Patel
Sr. Product Manager, QuickMart
[sent from mobile]

Attachments: usage_snapshot.json (5 KB), trial_logs.csv (14 KB)

From: priyom_das@redwoodinference.com <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@quickmart.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick start help — self-serve trial + next steps

Hi Samira — great to hear the trial is showing signal, thanks for the snapshot. I copied Ben (AE) and Monica (Customer Success) so we can tailor the session. A few quick qualification items so we make the demo actionable: 

1) Primary objective for the demo — high-level overview vs. ops deep-dive (model routing, batching, quantization, cost trade-offs)?
2) Is the 2M calls/day estimate steady-state or a projected number once rolled out? Any expected ramp shape?
3) Do you have security requirements (SOC 2, CCPA/data residency) that would push you toward Dedicated/Private?
4) Latency SLO: you mentioned 95th ~120ms — is that strict for the pilot or production target?
5) Do you want us to pre-load a small sandbox with your sample dataset for live comparisons?

Suggested demo windows (all PST): Thu May 20 10:00–10:45, Fri May 21 09:00–09:45, Mon May 24 11:30–12:15. If none of these work, share 2 mornings you prefer.

We can also invite your CTO if you want the architecture discussion — feel free to CC them.

Action: if you reply with the answers to Q1–Q4 and preferred slot, we'll lock it and prepare a sandbox sketch.

Best,
Priyom Das
SDR, Redwood Inference

Hi Priyom,

Thanks — answers below and I've looped in Vikram (our CTO) for any architecture questions: 

Q1: High-level + ops touch — start with a tailored overview (20m) then ops deep dive for 20–25m focused on latency/cost.
Q2: 2M/day is target for Q4 production; right now the trial traffic is ~80k/day. Ramp expected over 8–12 weeks after pilot if results look good.
Q3: Yes — SOC 2 is required for our vendors; data residency is US-only. Pilot can use hosted API if logs are controlled, but Dedicated/Private may be needed for production.
Q4: 95th 120ms is a production target; pilot can be more lenient (200–250ms) as long as we can measure throughput and degradation modes.

Preferred demo window: Fri May 21 09:00 PST works for us. Vikram will join that call.

Also attached a small usage snapshot and a sanitized sample (usage_snapshot.json) with traffic cadence — hope that helps with pre-configuring a sandbox.

Thanks —
Samira

I'll also create a HubSpot meeting link to capture the demo and next actions: https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/ben_carter/quickmart-demo.

See you Fri — I'll send a calendar invite and a tiny pre-demo checklist (SSO, sample dataset access).
